prompt: For viable cell density between CHO-007-R01 and CHO-007-R02, what are the mean signed difference and the largest absolute difference, and when does the largest occur? Use exact matching elapsed sample times and define differences as CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01. Report the mean signed difference, largest absolute difference, its elapsed time in hours, and name both batches. Include the deliveries still in review and state their provisional status.

output.content:
Comparing viable cell density at 14 exact matched elapsed sample times from 0.0 to 193.0 h, with the difference defined as CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01:

- **Mean signed difference: −26,452 cells/mL** (on average R02 ran slightly below R01).
- **Largest absolute difference: 696,666 cells/mL at 169.0 elapsed hours**, where CHO-007-R02 read 6,783,333 cells/mL and CHO-007-R01 read 6,086,667 cells/mL (R02 higher).

These figures are descriptive only: successive samples of one run are not independent, and the batch records do not note product, process version, equipment, scale or stage, so nothing here attributes the difference to a cause. All samples matched exactly; no interpolation or unmatched times were involved.

The values are **provisional** — they were read from the Northfield Biologics November runs delivery (CHO-007-R01 and CHO-007-R02 sit in it) and have not yet been reviewed, so verify the delivery before relying on them. The other deliveries still in review, which I did not use here, are Northfield Biologics October runs (CHO-004-R01/R02, CHO-005-R01/R02, CHO-006-R01/R02) and Harborview CDMO fed-batch runs (CHO-010-R01/R02, CHO-011-R01/R02, CHO-012-R01/R02).
